final_gaps.summary: The metric_alarm manager's sdkapi interface definition is not in the supplied evidence; it is required to know which CloudWatch operations the update path may call for tag reconciliation.

Availability of TagResource/UntagResource operations on the manager's SDK client/interface (or a generated tag-sync helper) is not evidenced, so the required additions, value changes, and removals cannot be bound to a real consumer.

No evidenced mechanism reads the current externally stored tags (for example ListTagsForResource) or an existing tag-diff helper needed to distinguish additions, value changes, removals, and the unchanged case.
